mapper.insert: INSERT INTO egon_cola_operation_log_receipt (id, tenant_id, occurred_at, payload_sha256, create_user_id, create_time, update_user_id, update_time, version, deleted_at) VALUES (#{et.id}, #{et.tenantId}, #{et.occurredAt}, #{et.payloadSha256}, #{et.createUserId}, #{et.createTime}, #{et.updateUserId}, #{et.updateTime}, #{et.version}, #{et.deletedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT occurred_at, payload_sha256 FROM egon_cola_operation_log_receipt WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
